BASE: Only scripts/e2e-scan.mjs, a developer script that points at a running demo.
CHROME_PATH: Only scripts/audit-interactions.mjs, a developer script (the README names CHROME for the audits).
SHOTS: Only scripts/e2e-scan.mjs, a developer script: a folder for screenshots.
SNAPSHOT_PORT: Only scripts/demo-snapshot.mjs, a developer script: the port it builds the snapshot on.
WASM: Only scripts/e2e-scan.mjs, a developer script: forces the scanner's WebAssembly path.
TMPDIR: A system variable (the operating system's temporary folder).
DEMO_TODAY: Set by the demo server itself for the demo's own day; not a setting a person chooses.
DEMO_TODAY_SET: Set by the demo server itself to say DEMO_TODAY came from it; never set by hand.
EVALS_STRICT: Set by CI so a stale recording fails the build; the README names the strict evals in the Tests paragraph.
